m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The lava tube is blocked? This is terrible news! The lava backflow could destroy the Fire Dwarves! Even if it doesn't, the Pumps are shut down!
The Wizard did this! Oh yah! The Wizard is an agent of Bat, if not Bat himself, dontcha know!
We should imprison this traitor until they tell us-
The Steam Vents! The Fire Dwarves have shut them off!
There's no way. The magic Portal between our cities was dismantled decades ago. We've got no way to reach them!
Eh, can you blame 'em? They must think we're trying to kill 'em! We have to tell 'em what's happened.
No... not yet. But I know what to do - I will reach them. Wizard!
There's an ancient Tunnel that leads to the Core, see? You and I will take it down there and talk to the Fire Dwarves.
What about the Terror? It won't just let you pass!
Now how do we know that's not just a bedtime story? The Wizard and I will take our chances with the Terror... if it's even down there.
Now, Wizard - to get into the Tunnel we'll want to get some things from the Vault. Let's get to it, eh?
Oh, yah, you want to get in the Vault? That'll be a problem!
The lava turned to stone? Oh, that's not good! If the tube's plugged, it'll be backed up down in the Core! And we can't melt ice for the Pumps, either!
Okay we'll get the tube cleared, but it'll take time. Until we do, who knows what's happening down below!
Oh, this is bad. Real bad. You'll want to go and tell the Council there. I'm worried something bad's gonna happen, you betcha!
The lava tube's blocked! Oh, this is bad. Very, very bad. Go tell the Council, wontcha?
